text:
Elaine (CSM): Kicking off Marina Logistics onboarding. High-level goals: connect their app to Redwood hosted API, validate SSO, stream audit logs to Splunk, and run a 30-day pilot with a 5k/day token cap. Need to agree stakeholders, success criteria, and timeline.
Tom (Solutions Eng): I can own the integration playbook and test harness. Proposal: 10 business days discovery -> 10 business days integration -> 30-day pilot.
Priya (Onboard PM): Ill make a milestone tracker and update this thread. Need Marina IAM contact and who owns their Splunk forwarding.
Marta (Marina IT): Hi, Marta here. IAM lead is Vivek, Splunk owned by Operations team (Anya). We can commit to a 2-week SSO window but need the schedule firmed up.
Raj (Security): Reminder: Marina handles PHI in one product line. Before any production traffic we need a completed SOC2 self-attestation, dataflow diagram, and the encryption-at-rest verification. Ill send the checklist.
Zoe (Success Ops): Ill bundle enablement materials: API quickstart, onboarding checklist (SSO, logs, env keys), and a recorded walkthrough.
Elaine (CSM): Draft success criteria: 1) SSO via SAML complete + test user login, 2) Audit events visible in Marina Splunk index for generation calls, 3) Integration test suite passing (>=95% on acceptance prompts), 4) Pilot 95th pctl latency <350ms, 5) No P0 incidents for 7 consecutive days. Additions? :thinking_face:
Tom (Solutions Eng): Add: seed prompt set + deterministic diff checks for output stability. Ill add a minimal curl example for their infra team:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"sanity check"}'
```
Priya (Onboard PM): Workshop options: Wed 10:00 PT or Thu 14:00 PT. Which works for Marina? Ill block 1h and capture action items.
Marta (Marina IT): Wed 10:00 PT works. Vivek (IAM) and Anya (Ops) will join.
calendar-bot: Event created "Marina Logistics  Onboarding Workshop" Wed 10:00:00 PT. Attendees: Elaine, Tom, Priya, Raj, Marta, Vivek, Anya. :calendar:
Elaine (CSM): Risks: if SOC2 items or SSO delay >45 days this becomes a renewal risk. Escalation path: loop in Renewals and AM if pilot start delayed. Action items: Tom -> integration playbook (3d), Raj -> SOC2 checklist (48h), Priya -> milestone tracker + invite (done), Zoe -> enablement pack (EOD).
Tom (Solutions Eng): Will upload playbook draft and a link to the test harness repo by EOD.
Raj (Security): SOC2 questionnaire sent to Marta. Please return with a dataflow diagram attached.
Marta (Marina IT): Thanks, team. Ill circulate IAM contact details during the workshop and confirm Splunk ingest path.
Elaine (CSM): Perfect. Ill run weekly pilot health check calls and collect feedback; if early signals are positive well start renewal conversations mid-pilot. :rocket:
